curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify words with the sounds /æ/ / ɔː / /i:/ /u:/ / ɔɪ / and / eɪ / for oral fluency

interactions.prompt: Which word has the /æ/ sound heard in cat?
Which word has the long /i:/ sound?
interactions.retryHint: Listen for the long ee sound.

interactions.prompt: Match each sound to its echo word.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a sound, then its word.
interactions.retryHint: Say every word aloud and stretch its middle sound.

interactions.prompt: Which pair shows /ɔɪ/ and /eɪ/ in that order?
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Boy has /ɔɪ/ and day has /eɪ/.

interactions.prompt: Sort the words heard at a picnic by their middle sound.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then its sound.
interactions.feedback: Amazing listening across all six sounds!
interactions.retryHint: Stretch the middle of each word.

choices: bag, ball, feet, food, coin, plate
ball, bag, food, feet, plate, coin
coin, plate, bag, ball, food, feet
interactions.answer: bag, ball, feet, food, coin, plate
interactions.feedback: Oral-fluency star! You identified every target sound.
interactions.retryHint: Check each word against one sound at a time.
